choices: To set the version of Java used to compile the class
To uniquely identify the class version so deserialization can detect incompatible changes
To control the order in which fields are serialized
To specify how many instances can be deserialized
explanation: serialVersionUID is a version stamp. If you deserialize a stream with a different serialVersionUID than the current class definition, an InvalidClassException is thrown. Declare it as 'private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;' to control compatibility explicitly.
